title: How a Man Escaped Deputies at 140 mph Before the Surprise of His Life
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On May 17, 2024, a Columbia County Sheriff's deputy attempted to stop a speeding motorcycle. The motorcyclist fled, struck an unmarked squad car, and evaded deputies again, forcing them to end the pursuit for safety reasons. The sheriff's office obtained the motorcycle's license plate number and began an investigation to locate the registered owner. They eventually located the man's residence, where he admitted to fleeing because he couldn't afford another speeding ticket.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
